Delivery by lower segment cesarean section (LSCS)
lack of prenatal advice on breastfeeding
finding: Rates of early initiation of breastfeeding were very low, and factors affecting it included delivery by lower segment cesarean section, lack of prenatal advice on breastfeeding, use of prelacteal feeds, and maternal illness.
mod_finding: Delivery by lower segment cesarean section was found to be a factor affecting early initiation of breastfeeding.
